summary: PR-1202 adds CaseService.reopen, which changes a case from WITHDRAWN to DRAFT and saves it without recording an audit event. That violates AUD-1, and no exception covers it. The process records are in order: an approved ticket covering mortgage.cases, an independent change_approver review on the head commit, and a green CI run on the head commit with the relevant control tests passing. Those AUD-1 and LOG-1 tests only check fixed cases, though, and don't exercise reopen. The PR also says unit tests were updated, but no test files changed. The change should add an audit.record call in reopen with a test, then go through review again.
